validation_metrics.source_annotation_recall_note: A merged GT may have multiple provenance strata; it counts once per (source,class). Provenance never changes matching or threshold selection.

selection.note: 95% empirical validation precision is not a guarantee of deployment precision. No thresholds are fitted on test/regression.

latency.includes: disk decode, synthetic corruption if any, YOLO preprocessing/NMS, optional all-ROI classification, CPU output transfer and CUDA sync
latency.excludes: capture, networking, robot planning/actuation, output file writes

duplicate_audit.grouping: Global connected components of reference and benchmark RGB/hash identities; test-only representative is first non-conflicting input row.
duplicate_audit.limitation: Perceptual hashes are conservative proxies, not proof of different farms/trees or all possible source overlap.

limitations: No test-time architecture, checkpoint or threshold fitting.
Image-level annotations never establish detection/localization mAP.
Blur/brightness/downscale are synthetic stress tests, not flight/video evidence.
Other diseases are negatives for the specific target; this is not a universal diagnostic system.
False-action matches describe risk, not executed removals or proven economic savings.

target_metrics.note: Negative-class action counts are conservative one-to-one matches, not executed removals. Other-disease alerts are FP for the specific target.

all_classes_at_fixed_threshold.matching: confidence-descending greedy, one-to-one, class-aware after explicit remapping

healthy_mistaken_actions.definition: symptom predictions matched class-agnostically to all GT at IoU>=0.5; count matched healthy GT

all_classes_at_fixed_threshold.uncertainty_note: Wilson intervals treat pods as independent; same-tree/capture dependence can widen uncertainty.
